sources.title: Introducing Meta Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2)
sources.snippet: SAM 2 is a segmentation model that enables fast, precise selection of any object in any video or image.

sources.title: SAM 2 – Promptable Segmentation for Images and Videos
sources.snippet: SAM 2 (Segment Anything Model 2) is the next iteration in the SAM family of models for Promptable Visual Segmentation on images and videos in real-time.
